excerpt: If we offer agreements with a non-disparagement clause, that clause will not preclude raising safety concerns, nor will it preclude disclosure of the existence of that clause.
paraphrase: Any non-disparagement clause used will permit both raising safety concerns and disclosing the clause's existence.

excerpt: Internal review: We will regularly conduct an internal review of our implementation of this policy.
paraphrase: Anthropic will regularly review internally how it implements this policy.

excerpt: Procedural compliance review: On approximately an annual basis, we will commission a third-party review that assesses whether we adhered to this policy's main procedural commitments.
paraphrase: Anthropic will commission an annual third-party review of adherence to the policy's procedural commitments.

excerpt: This review will focus on procedural compliance, not substantive outcomes.
paraphrase: The review examines procedural adherence rather than substantive outcomes.

excerpt: Policy changes: Changes to the RSP will be proposed by the CEO and RSO, and approved by the Board in consultation with the LTBT.
paraphrase: RSP changes are proposed by the CEO and RSO and approved by the Board with LTBT consultation.

excerpt: If we update the RSP, we will publicly share the updated version prior to or on its effective date and will record the differences from the prior draft in the Change Log.
paraphrase: RSP updates will be published by their effective date, with changes recorded in the Change Log.

excerpt: We will maintain the current version of the RSP on our website.
paraphrase: The current RSP version is kept publicly available on Anthropic's website.

section_heading: Appendix A: Commitments Related to Competitors
excerpt: These commitments are necessarily high-level and limited. In many cases, we will not have enough information to determine that the relevant scenario applies and will have to use our best judgment to deal with uncertainty.
paraphrase: The competitor-related commitments are inherently high-level and require judgment given uncertain applicability.

section_heading: Appendix A: Commitments Related to Competitors
excerpt: But to the extent that other relevant AI developers prioritize safety and invest in legible demonstrations that they are doing so—as we intend to—commitments like this may help avoid an inadvertent "race to the bottom" on safety.
paraphrase: If other developers similarly demonstrate safety prioritization, such commitments could help prevent a safety race to the bottom.

section_heading: Appendix A: Commitments Related to Competitors
excerpt: Further, the commitments below do not preclude us from taking cautionary action, such as refraining from training or deploying models, in other circumstances.
paraphrase: These commitments do not limit Anthropic's ability to take cautionary action in other situations.

section_heading: Appendix A: Commitments Related to Competitors
excerpt: Mitigating the risks from our models is a top priority for us, and we would strongly consider pausing development and/or deployment to improve the safety profiles of our models even in cases not covered below.
paraphrase: Risk mitigation remains a top priority, and pausing development or deployment would be strongly considered even beyond the listed scenarios.

paraphrase: The scenario describes Anthropic imminently developing a highly capable model with clear evidence no competitor will soon match it.

paraphrase: In the lead scenario, Anthropic requires a strong argument that catastrophic risk is contained, consistent with its industry-wide safety recommendations.

section_heading: Appendix A: Commitments Related to Competitors
